playerLine: I climb the seawall before the patrol comes round.
narration: Your fingers find the ledge and you haul yourself over the top in one smooth pull. On the far side the stones are dry and the patrol's lantern is still a long way off.

characterContext.playerSummary: A ferry-hand with a borrowed name.
